ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central lobes bifurcated by a dark, wedge-shaped central pigmentation zone; solid black banding along the distal trailing edges with dense mottling/speckling at the interface of white and black regions, particularly concentrated on the proximal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley pixel variance ranges between 4 and 8 pixels, with higher irregularity observed on the distal end of the right lobe (viewer left).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; the right lobe (viewer left) exhibits a steeper upward convexity towards the tip, while the left lobe (viewer right) follows a more gradual, elongated curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels located on the dark distal edge of the right lobe (viewer left), indicative of barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/indentation is visible on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer left), disrupting the uniform serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in pigmentation width, where the black trailing edge band on the right lobe (viewer left) is significantly wider and more heavily mottled than on the left lobe (viewer right).
